Step:  
Start: 1573-08-23  
Subtract 6 months → 1573-02-23  
Subtract 27 days:  
February 1573 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1573 not divisible by 4), so Feb has 28 days.  
From Feb 23, subtract 23 days → Feb 0 (i.e., Jan 31).  
Remaining 4 days: Jan 31 → Jan 27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1573-01-27
